Satellite Nayif-1 (Emirates OSCAR 88, EO 88)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Status Reentry 2023-07-20. Was operational (Last SatNOGS report with data on 2023-06-09 last checked 2023-06-09)
Launched 2017-02-15
NORAD ID 42017
Deployer QuadPack (XL) [ISISpace]
Launcher PSLV
Organisation Mohammed Bin Rashid Space Centre (MBRSC)
Institution Institute
Entity type Government (Civil / Military)
Nation (HQ) United Arab Emirates
Nation (AIT) Netherlands
Manufacturer AIVT by ISISpace
Launch brokerer ISILaunch
Partners American University of Sharjah, ISISpace
Oneliner

Educational training and amateur radio communications.
Description

Goal of providing an actual space project for Emirati University students. Additionally it is intended to enthuse and educate young people about radio, space physics and electronics. Carries the FUNcube 5 amateur communications payload.
